transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1724 Beaver Brook Drive?
Yes, this is 1724 Beaver Brook Drive. Everyone here is safe and we’re not in any immediate danger.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There are five people here total, and everyone can come to the phone.

Thank you for confirming everyone can use the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I just want to clarify — no one is bedbound or uses a wheelchair, so there’s no motorized equipment involved.
Understood, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?

No, there’s no water inside the home right now.  
*(corrects themselves)*  
Actually, there are five people here, and no one needs to leave alone.
Understood, no water inside and all are together safely. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No water inside and everyone’s safe here. I don’t have a truck, boat, or any free seats to offer.
Understood, no vehicles or seats available. Let me read that back: 5 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — five people, no water inside yet. Just to clarify, I’m safe and no one needs to leave alone.
Thank you for confirming your safety and clarity. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
